children: IRB Infrastructure Developers, Ola Electric Mobility and Tega Industries were among the stocks that moved the Nifty 500 higher at market open on Thursday, September 10, while HEG,Craftsman Automation and Sai Life Sciences slipped lower.

Monthly toll revenue data featured among day's triggers, as IRB Infrastructure Developers advanced after reporting a 25% rise in gross toll collections for August. Meanwhile, HEG extended its decline toward its 52-week low.

IRB Infrastructure Developers shares rose up to 8% at market open after the company reported gross toll revenue rising approximately 25% to ₹807 crore in August 2026, compared with ₹646 crore in August 2025. The company's shares had fallen almost 5% since the beginning of the year and more than 5% in the past year. The stock was at a 19.4% decline from its 52-week high of ₹23.95 and 6.8% away from hitting its 52-week low of ₹18.76. Over 3 crore shares of the company were traded on the stock market at 2.21 times the stock's 10-day average.

Ola Electric Mobility shares rose over 5% at market open. The company's shares had risen more than 3% since the beginning of the year and fallen over 34% in the past year. The stock was at a 56.9% decline from its 52-week high of ₹61.02 and 74.6% away from hitting its 52-week low of ₹22.25. Over 4 crore shares of the company were traded at 0.79 times the stock's 10-day average.

Tega Industries shares rose up to 4% at market open. The company's shares had fallen almost 11% since the beginning of the year and more than 16% in the past year. The stock was at a 22.3% decline from its 52-week high of ₹2,125 and 17.8% away from hitting its 52-week low of ₹1,473. Over 4 lakh shares of the company were traded at 1.22 times the stock's 10-day average.

HEG shares fell up to 4% at market open. The company's shares had fallen more than 59% since the beginning of the year and almost 50% in the past year. The stock was 1.5% away from hitting its 52-week low of ₹251.10. Over 3.5 lakh shares of the company were traded at 0.17 times the stock's 10-day average.

Craftsman Automation shares fell over 3% at market open. The company's shares had risen more than 48% since the beginning of the year and more than 72% in the past year. The stock was at a 4.5% decline from its 52-week high of ₹11,999. Over 18,000 shares of the company were traded at 0.26 times the stock's 10-day average.

Sai Life Sciences shares fell up to 2.5% at market open. The company's shares had risen almost 82% since the beginning of the year and almost 90% in the past year. The stock was at a 3.7% decline from its 52-week high of ₹1,697. Over 1.5 lakh shares of the company were traded at 0.13 times the stock's 10-day average.

title: IRB Infra, Ola Electric lead Nifty 500 gainers; HEG, Craftsman Automation fall at market open
